tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// sems kyi mtshan nyid gab pa mngon du phyung ba bzhugs so//

༄༅// na mo ratna gu ru/ sems kyi mtshan nyid gab pa mngon du phyung ba'i man ngag /bla ma yid bzhin nor bu'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo// nam mkha'i mtha' la brtag par mi nus mod// sems kyi mtshan nyid rig pa ma yin no// ma rig bskyed pa rgyu dang mi ldan mod// de phyir tha mar 'gag pa ga la mchis// de phyir rten 'brel sgro btags min ri shi /de ltar rig na 'ching grol byed ri shi /dang po nyid nas sems la thog mtha' med// de phyir sems can 'khrul pa'i rgyu ma mthong*// sangs rgyas grol ba'i rkyen yang ngas ma rig /sangs rgyas sems can gnyis su ma phyed pas// tha snyad 'dogs pa'i lung sa bor nas thal// 'khor ba mthong ba shes mkhan skyon can yin// myang 'das rtogs pa de dang dbyer ma phyed// skyon yon rtogs na gang de mtha' lhung can// gang du'ang mi byed gang du'ang mthar mi mngon// sangs rgyas sems can snga phyi ma mthong bas// gnyis pas gcig (2na)kyang nged kyis ma rig go /rmi lam khungs kyi sgro btags ji snyed 'dis// sgyu ma'i sems can ji snyed mgo 'khor langs// rang mtshang rig pa srid mtha' ma bkag tsam// rang gis rang bcings srin gyi kha chu bzhin// rang gis rang grol sbrul gyi mdud pa bzhin// 'ching grol med pa rmi lam sad pa 'dra// thog ma med nas sems can bcings pa med// bsod nams tshogs kyis sangs rgyas grol ma mthong*// tshul lugs 'di 'dra nam mkha' bstan par zad// rtogs mkhan yod na de rang 'ching byed yin// a pha gnyid sad rmi lam gang du song*// 'du shes bral bas spang rtogs rdul tsam med// mkhas par rlom pa'i skye bo rmongs pa rnams// nang du blta ba'i ye shes spyan dang bral// sgyu ma'i gzugs la legs nyes rtog pa 'khrul// 'khor 'das chos la 'dam ka byed mkhan blun// chu nang gzugs brnyan bden pa su zhig blta// spangs rtogs sgro btags su (2ba)la bden par mngon// bden par 'dzin pa'i bud shing tshig bcom na// 'khor 'das kun gyi sa bon rul pa yin// ji ltar snang ba'i shes pa gra ma nyams// zur ma chag par gyad langs byed pa 'di// sangs rgyas dngos su zhal phyag lam me ba// 'di la phri snon bzang ngan yod ri shi

/zhe 'dod gcong gis skad cig ma bslad par// kha zhe'i nad kyis rang la ma bslus par// gnyis 'dzin dri mas skad cig ma sbags na// gang gang de rang chos sku'i gyad longs yin// la la'i bzhed kyis mnyam bzhag brtan pa las// rjes kyi bar mtshams med par 'od gsal nyid// khor mo yug tu song bas sangs rgyas kyi// dgongs pa mngon du byas par 'dod pa mang*// rang gis go tshul 'di ltar khums pa yin// mnyam rjes gnyis ka lcags zad bdar zad du// bag chags bcas pa gtan dag nyid brlag nas// tha mal shes pa rjen pa chos skur go /'khrul pa'i gong na ma 'khrul 'di 'dra zhes// de med phyir na 'khrul pa'ang dmigs su med// de phyir sangs rgyas sems can mgo mnyam yin// 'khor 'das gnyis med chos sku nyid la mtshungs// dri mas bkrus pa'i 'khrul pa kha gang ma// ji bzhin de rang ye shes nyid du khums// zhe 'dod nyid kyis skad cig ma bslad pa// ji bzhin de rang sangs rgyas dgongs par khums// yengs pa'i tshe na dran pa mi g.yo zhing*// 'khrul pa'i dus su gnyen po ma sbron pa// gang gang gzugs de skad cig bcos mi dgos// 'di 'dra gang de bcing grol med pa yin// yon tan 'dod tshad zhe 'dod gcong gis zin// 'bras bu 'dod tshad re ba'i sad kyis khyer// rtags mtshan 'dod tshad (3na)bdud kyi go rar tshud// 'dod blo skad cig med pa 'tshams pa las// kun brtags lbu ba'i gzugs kyis byis pa bslus// sgro btags yon tan 'dod pas rang nyid bcings// 'bras bu 'chi dus btab pas khong gcong rgyas// rang gis rang la brdzun gyi mgo bskor byas// blang dor phyogs kyi grol ba phyogs re thong*// blang dor ci yang ma byas lam ma btsal// 'bras bu ci yang ma mthong re dwogs zhi// sgro btags rigs pas brdzun gyi mgo skor sangs// de yang nang du gzigs la sems ma mthong*// de med sangs rgyas sems can sus bskyed pa// thams cad mnyam nyid yin te de yang ming*// ming tsam btags pa tsam la ma zhen mdzod// rgyu yis ci bskyed 'bras bu de 'dra na// byas pa'i chos kyi 'bras bu 'dus byas yin// ma byas chos kyi 'bras bu ci zhig 'tshol// brdzun gyis brdzun byas nam zhig bcing 'gyur na// blo gros can dag byed mkhan khungs chod dang*// gzhan la mi ltos rang gis thag chod kyis// nam mkha'i mtshan nyid 'di ni mtshar bar 'dug

/byis pa'i rtsed mo rgan la cang bden nam// kun rdzob bden par mkhas pas cang 'dzin nam// chos dang chos min ye nas gnyis mchis sam// med na mthong mkhan de rang 'khrul par zad// yengs pa'i tshe na 'khrul pa rang mtshan pa// dran tshe ngo bo gud nas thob pa zhig /de 'dra gang de gnyis chos ma rig pas// sgom la thob shor de ni ngas ma rtogs// gnyis chos yod na blang dor rig pa la// med par byed pa de rang skyon can yin// ye nas 'khrul na grol ba gud na med// ye grol glo bur dri ma ga la mchis// rtag (3ba)par gyur na ther zug sgyur du med// chad par gyur na gang nas btsal du med// ye shes de ni gang na'ang ma mchis na// thob bya zhen pa de rang 'khrul mkhan yin// cho 'phrul thams cad nam mkha'i rnam 'phrul yin// nam mkhas ci yang skad cig byas pa med// de mtshang rig na bcing grol gos pa med// gos pa kun gyis gos par mi 'gyur phyir// sems can dus nas 'khrul pa rang mtshan pa// skad cig yod na grol ba der 'gyur te// sems can 'khrul pa'i ngo bo ma mchis pas// sangs rgyas grol ba'i ye shes su la mngon// nam mkha'i mdud pas su yang bcing du med// nam mkha' grol bas su yang glod du med// dang po sems can dmigs par ma gyur pas// phyis nas sangs rgyas yod pa su yi lugs// dang po sems nyid yod par ma gyur pas// gnas 'gyu ye shes de ni su la rig /des na byas dang byed pa thams cad kun// nam mkha'i so nam dka' las nyid du zad// de ltar rig na ma byas lam kun 'grub// bar snang ngos la rdul khrod rten med bzhin// 'dus ma byas la bag chags rten mi 'byung*// gnyis snang rab rib dbang po'i skyon yin ltar// dge sdig byed pa sems kyi rang skyon yin// gang du 'ang mi byed skyon yon gos mi 'gyur// cir yang mi 'dzin gol sar su zhig lhung*// zhe 'dod med par re dogs ci las byung*// lta ba med par mtho dma' su yis 'dogs// 'du shes nyid kyis de rang ma bcings na// de rang stong phyir gzhan zhig ci yang med// med bzhin snang ba nam mkha'i cho 'phrul yin// shes pas grol ba rmi lam sad pa yin// sna tshogs snang ba stong pa'i ri mo yin// don du 'dzin pa byis (4na)pa'i ngang tshul yin// skyon yon med pa sgyu ma'i rang gzugs yin// nam mkha'i ltad mo 'di ka mtshar bar gda'// blta shes can la nam mkha'i ltad mo che// sgom nyams can la sna tshogs lam du che// gdams ngag can la 'gal rkyen grogs su che// 'di 'dra'i tshul lugs byis pa'i rang bzhin yin// gtad sa med par phyal par btang ba yin// gzung ba med par dran 'dzin bor ba yin// bsgom med ngang la tha mal lus pa yin// bdag po med pas ci dga' mu dga' yin// he he nam mkhas ci yang byas pa med// 'on kyang cho 'phrul nam mkha'i rnam 'gyur yin// gzugs nas rnam mkhyen nam mkha'i ri mo yin// nam mkha' 'di las mthu stobs che ma mthong*// stong pa'i rnam 'gyur 'di tsam gang shong na// sems kyi 'char sgo 'di tsam ci la skyes// rtog pa'i rnam grangs 'di tsam gang nas shar// sgom chen pa de 'dod pa'i gal du chung*// 'di 'dra mthong bas sgyu ma'i skyes bu rgod// ci yang thob pa med pa'i bde skyid dang*// tha mal shes pas chog pa'i nyams len 'di// sangs rgyas mi gzugs can gyi drin las rnyed// da nge gang byung chog pa 'di rang mtshar// 'bras bu re dwogs med pa'i khong gcong zhi// gnas 'gyu 'dam kha med pas gang byung chog

/dran pa'i 'tsho skyong med pas yengs dogs med// mnyam rjes res mor med pas thun mtshams bral// gang byung chos kyi dbyings la blang dor med// thams cad sgro btags yin pa'i rdzun phugs rig /sgro 'dogs sems la chod dang sgom chen kun// sems las chos gzhan med par shes nas mchis// sems (4ba)nyid gzhi rtsa med par rtogs par nges// sgom med yengs med gnad cig 'char bar mchis// spangs thob med pa'i don gcig rtogs par mchis// snga nas skad cig 'khor bar 'khyams ma mthong*// da lta phyin chad skad cig grol ma rig /gnyid las sad pa'i rmi lam rang yal ltar// rdzun phugs rig pas 'khrul grol rmi lam sangs// sgom chen rnams la mgo 'thums ci byung na// sems can rnams la 'khrul pa sus bslabs na// 'phags pa rnams kyis grol ba gang nas btsal// bde chen rang ngo shes pa'i dam pa rnams// bcings grol gol sa med pa'i ngang tshul yin// gnad 'di rig na kun la de ltar gsal// nang du ltos shig rang la yang dang yang*// lta mkhan bltas pas rang mtshang rang gis rig /rgyu mtshan shes pas bcings grol 'dag pa yin// dran pas thob dang yengs pas 'khrul pa rnams// blo yis bzung mod don la thob shor med// 'khor 'das gnyis su blo yis nan gyis bzung*// dge sdig gnyis kyi bde sdug gnyis su myong*// bde sdug snang dus don la ci yang med// mngar ba zhim mod skyur ba'ang zhim par 'dzin// blo yis bzung ba nyid las don la med// ci yang ma bzung ci yang dgos pa med// cir yang shar ba cir yang mi 'dzin pa// lam mchog 'di las gong du 'phul sa med// bag chags 'thas pa'i mi snang dgu snang 'di// 'dzin med goms byas ma spangs gnas dag yin// blo yis bzung tshad mtshan ma'i sa bon yin// cir yang mi 'dzin skyes grol dus mnyam yin// de rnams thams cad blo yi sgro btags yin// ltos shig ltos shig ci yang ma (5na)blta zhig

/sgoms shig sgoms shig ci yang ma sgom zhig /rmi lam 'di la cir yang ma 'dzin cig /ji ltar bzung yang de rang mtshang rig na// gang ltar byas kyang skyon yon gos pa med// gos pa kun gyis gos kyang 'gal ba med// de 'dra'i grol tshad gang zag yas med du// song nas mtshan mar 'dzin pa zhig pa yin// lar na nang du 'khu 'phrig ma chod na// rjes la rang spyod bstan pa chos nyid yin// the tshom nang du zhi ba'i rnam 'gyur la// sgo gsum gleng slong gzhan gyis spros pa gcod// nges med klong du mtshan ma'i blo zhi nas// snang dang stong pas phan gnod byas pa med// bdar sha sems la chod la gcod mkhan ltos// 'di yis gdams ngag thams cad ston pa yin// 'di yis yod med thams cad 'bud pa yin// yin lugs thams cad 'di yis ston pa yin// sgom mkhan gtan la phebs pa'i bla ma 'di// 'du 'bral med par rang la bzhugs pa yin// bri gang med par gtan du 'grogs pa yin// bla ma de yi gsung la nyan pa nyung*// phyir bltas kha yis zab mo'i mtshang mi rig /nyams myong med par gnad kyi don mi go /kha lta yug pos mi la chos mi ston// rgyu 'bras khyad gsod mi la gnad mi gsung*// sgrub pas dben pa de la bshad mi rung*// des na chos kyi mdo don nyams len yin// nyams su blangs pa'i 'bras bu sangs rgyas yin// sangs rgyas rnams ni chos kyi sku can yin// chos sku de ni mtshan ma'i dri ma bral// ji ltar blo yis bzung ba mtshan ma yin// blo yis cir yang ma bzung cir yang snang*// spros pa'i dri mas rgyud la gos pa med// thog ma'i 'khrul pa 'di nas byung (5ba)ba med// tha ma'i grol ba 'di nas thob pa med// bar gyi 'khrul pa ngo bo 'di yin med// de ltar rig na bcing grol gos pa med// sems med rtogs na snang srid rgya yan yin// rtsis gdab med na rnam rtog skyes grol yin// zhe 'dod med na thams cad mnyam nyid yin// de ltar rtogs na sgom la rgyun chad med// skye 'chi med pas 'pho ba'i rgyal po yin// mtshan 'dzin med pas 'od gsal khor mo yug

/ji srid 'dzin pa'i rtod phur ma phyin par// de srid rnam rtog yod pas las gsog pas// ma yengs dran pa'i bya ra brten pa legs// ci zhig goms pa klong du gyur pa'i tshe// dran dang ma dran las grol 'khu 'phrig sangs// rnal 'byor pa la re dwogs rdul tsam med// de tshe 'khor 'das thams cad klong du zhig /bsgom du med mod ma yengs bsgom pa dang*// zhi gdeng ma thob bar du goms pa 'tshal// yin lugs ston pa'i bla ma rang shar nas// mnyam rjes med pa'i klong du yan pa'i tshe// don gnyis gter la spyod pa chos nyid yin// des na dad dang brtson pas nyams len la// da res lam sna zin par ma byas na// phyis nas thar bar dka' yo skal ldan kun// da res 'bungs gsum chos la ma bton 1na// shi dus 'gyod pa skye 'o sgom chen kun// tshig rkyen de la sems la zhu gtugs mdzod// 'chi dus thag chod med na rang la gnod// skyid par 'dod na da lta sdug bsran bskyed// sangs rgyas 'dod na rang sems rtogs par mdzod// sems kyi mtshan nyid gab pa mngon du phyung ba'i man ngag /'gro ba sems can gyis snying la oṃ āḥhūṃ/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chos rgyal zla 'od gzhon nus/ rnal 'byor chos g.yung la (6na)gsungs pa'o/// /shubhaṃ/ ༈ mnyam med rin po che'i gsung 'bum mthong thos dran reg 'di'i/ ka pa nas pha pa'i bar gyi zhu dag pa ni/ byang ba rab 'byams ma ti kīrti dang*/ dwags po'i bhikṣu dzñā ni shwa ra gnyis kyis bgyis so// 'di la phri ba dang bsnan pa sogs kyi nyes pa med mod kyis/ 'on kyang brda' gsar rnying dang dag yig so so'i bzhed pa'i dbang gis/ ma go ba dang ma rig pa sogs kyis nyes pa 'dug na/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong sogs dang*/ gzhan yang dbus gtsang khams gsum gyi mkhas pa rnams kyis bzod par gsol// yi ge pa ni e phyogs mkhas pa yi// kun dga' rin chen dpon slob gsum gyis bris// shes bya 'di la 'gran zla cung zad med// dge ba 'di yis tshe rabs thams cad du// dal 'byor lus thob bstan la rab byung nas// 'chad rtsod rtsom pas gzhan rgyud smin pa dang*// thos bsam sgom pas rang rgyud smin par shog
/bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog /
